label: Ordered pairs give every point an address
subgoals: Escreva a etapa horizontal antes da etapa vertical

slice.rule: A point in the plane is written $(x, y)$: the first coordinate says how far east or west of the origin, the second how far north or south. To locate a point, move horizontally first, then vertically — the reverse order lands somewhere else entirely.

examples.says: 3 north then 2 east is $(2, 3)$ — a different point

slice.note: Horizontal first, always. The two orders give different points unless $x=y$.

label: Os eixos dividem o plano em quadrantes
subgoals: Cruze o eixo x e o eixo y na origem
Numere os quatro quadrantes com algarismos romanos
Ler (1, 2) como coordenada x 1, coordenada y 2

slice.rule: The axes cross at the origin $(0,0)$. The $x$-axis is horizontal and the $y$-axis vertical; together they divide the plane into four quadrants, numbered anticlockwise from the upper right. A point with a zero coordinate sits on an axis rather than in a quadrant.

label: Drill: endereços fora da grade da rua
subgoals: Conte 2 quarteirões a leste e 3 ao norte até o restaurante
Contagem 3 direita e 3 para baixo para a barra
Contagem 2 esquerda e 4 para baixo para o posto de gasolina

slice.rule: Apply the two rules together: read the pair, place it with a horizontal move then a vertical one, and check which quadrant it lands in.
